first_incident.entry_guard: The Dramaturgo chooses a later significant scene frame, not a literal next-turn car-to-workshop journey. Before the first choice, establish who can move the object, whose passage it is, the NPCs' independent physical reach and why the issue arises now. If this frame is untenable under new play evidence, block and reprepare.
